context.text: # validate gcc version for use fstack-protector-strong

findings.message: QNX software is built with the SDP compiler drivers (qcc for C, q++ for C++), selected with -V<variant>, not the host gcc.
findings.remedy: Do not hard-code the compiler; let the caller set CC/CXX (CC=qcc -Vgcc_ntoaarch64le after sourcing qnxsdp-env.sh) or supply a CMake toolchain file.

findings.title: Makefile branches on uname
findings.message: Platform is taken from the build host. When cross-compiling the host is Linux/macOS while the target is QNX; uname on a QNX host reports QNX.
findings.remedy: Key the logic on a target variable (for example TARGET_OS passed on the command line) rather than uname of the build machine.

findings.title: CMake project has no QNX toolchain/platform support
findings.message: No file in this tree mentions QNX. Cross-building for QNX with CMake needs a toolchain file.
findings.remedy: Provide a toolchain file: CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME QNX, CMAKE_C_COMPILER/CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER set to qcc/q++ with the -V variant (for example gcc_ntoaarch64le), roots from QNX_HOST/QNX_TARGET after sourcing qnxsdp-env.sh; run cmake -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=...
findings.verify: verify against SDP: variant names and the toolchain file template shipped with the SDP.
